goals.title: Oxygen 2.0 Dashboard Rebuild
goals.impact: Drove design + research for full redesign. Shipped 24 of 32 v2 components; WAU adoption reached 52% by end of cycle (target 80% by Q3).

goals.title: Design → Engineering Handoff Automation
goals.impact: Built Figma→Storybook automation; introduced clickable prototypes as the new spec format. Median handoff time fell from 4.2 to 3.4 days.

goals.title: Team Mentorship & Skill Development
goals.impact: Weekly 1:1s + portfolio reviews with Riya and Shreya. Both shipped 4+ features and were promotion-eligible by end of cycle.

goals.title: Accessibility WCAG 2.2 Compliance
goals.impact: Audited and fixed 45 accessibility violations across core apps. Created accessible color system tokens and keyboard navigation patterns.

goals.title: User Research & Usability Benchmarking
goals.impact: Completed 5 usability testing sessions with 30+ participant insights. Insights directly influenced the Q3 product roadmap priorities.
